structure.name: Average Weekly Earnings
structure.description: Dataset: AWE. Survey conducted biannually, in May and November, to measure the level of average gross weekly earnings associated with employees. While AWE is not designed to produce movement in earnings data, the frequency of collection supports a time series of these level estimates. Unit of measure: AUD. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 6302.0
